name: postman-api-tests
description: Postman/Newman API tests for the Toolshop practice API

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:search
scripts.test:search: newman run collections/toolshop-search-data-driven.postman_collection.json -e environments/toolshop.postman_environment.json -d data/search-terms.csv --reporters cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/search-data-driven.html --reporter-junit-export reports/search-data-driven.xml
